title: Choo-choo train, Skippy Core's chat model in one call (our incomplete harness)
model: Skippy Core's chat model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Q4), one call with MineBench's own prompt, the way MineBench runs a model
verdict: Harness fault, found 2026-10-31: this call was not MineBench's procedure. Our copy of its prompt lacked the TOOL MODE section ("you may use ONLY these runtime globals: block, box, line, rng, Math"), and MineBench sends a failure back for up to 8 attempts where this got one. Later runs in this series give a model MineBench's way. What it did here: In one reply (5 minutes, 5,052 tokens) it planned a sensible scene: a steam locomotive with a cowcatcher and boiler, a tender and passenger cars on a ballasted track with scenery, drawn with its own box, cylinder and sphere helpers. But every helper places blocks with voxel.setBlock, which MineBench does not give it (its code gets block(x, y, z, type)), so the code stops at the first block.
